data.reasoning: The deepseek model successfully reviewed all package files and correctly identified the PKGBUILD as a standard Python packaging script with pinned sources and standard build tools, finding no malicious injections. The qwen model's report is invalid due to API errors (HTTP 400) when attempting to review the PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO, which counts as a tool error and carries no verdict signal. There are no signs of malicious code or injection.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of the qwen model experiencing LLM API failures (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) while trying to audit the core packaging files, resulting in an 'inconclusive' verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited the same files and found them safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO and PKGBUILD due to LLM API request failures (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in missing coverage for the most critical files.
learnings: The audit tool should implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent a single model's infrastructure failure from skewing the overall consensus or triggering unnecessary escalations.
